# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Liquid --base-color 0.6392 0.6078 0.4235 --no-slot
material new Glass --base-color 0.6392 0.6784 0.5451 --no-slot
material new Cork --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Flask --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.16 --location 0 0 0.16
material assign Liquid
add mesh cylinder --name Neck --vertices 6 --radius 0.065 --depth 0.12 --location 0 0 0.34
material assign Glass
add mesh cube --name Cork --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.420
scale 0.100 0.100 0.070
apply --scale
material assign Cork
select all
shade flat
export potion_blue.glb
